item.title: Turning GLM-5.3-Flash into a Jev-like decision model
item.description:
📝 This approach makes it possible to turn an LLM into a Jev-like decision model. 3-Flash enables typed decisions on images, which is not possible with Jev. The prompt ends with choice_index:.
🔗 Read more: https://www.privatemode.ai/blog/system-one-from-glm-flash

item.title: Reverse-engineering the Intel 8087's tangent algorithm: more than CORDIC
item.description:
📝 One popular approach for trigonometric functions is an algorithm called CORDIC. The CORDIC algorithm CORDIC is a clever algorithm for quickly computing transcendental functions with simple hardware: it uses shift and add instructions along with table lookups, but doesn't need multiplication or division. CORDIC became popular, including in scientific calculators, which used decimal CORDIC instead of binary.
🔗 Read more: https://www.righto.com/2026/09/8087-tangent-cordic.html
